Young had replaced [[Clem Curtis]] during 1968, and this was the first Foundations hit on which he sang. It reached No. 1 on the ''[[Cashbox (magazine)|Cash Box]]'' Top 100{{cite web|url=http://cashboxmagazine.com/archives/60s_files/19690308.html |title=Top 100 1969-03-08 |work=[[Cashbox (magazine)|Cashbox Magazine]] |access-date=29 May 2016 }} and No. 3 on the US [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] in early 1969. It was also a No. 2 hit in the United Kingdom, for two non-consecutive weeks. It was quickly certified [[Gold record|Gold]] by the [[RIAA]] for sales of over a million US copies.

sections.heading: In popular culture
sections.wikitext:
"Build Me Up Buttercup" is featured in the 1998 romantic comedy film ''[[There's Something About Mary]]'',<ref>{{cite book|last=Pollock|first=Bruce|date=2005|title=Rock Song Index: The 7500 Most Important Songs for the Rock and Roll Era|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=GxYiAwAAQBAJ&pg=PA44|publisher=[[Routledge]]|page=44|isbn=978-0415970730}}</ref> the pilot episode "Truth Be Told" from the first season of the ABC TV spy drama series ''[[Alias (TV series)|Alias]]'', and the episode "Art Imitates Art" from the fourth season of the CBS TV detective series ''[[Elementary (TV series)|Elementary]]''. This song was played during the final scene of the second to last episode of Fuller House. The track also features in the 2020 film ''[[The Kissing Booth 2]]'',<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.radiotimes.com/movies/the-kissing-booth-2-soundtrack/|title=The Kissing Booth 2 soundtrack: Every song played in the sequel|last=Morris|first=Lauren|date=July 22, 2020|website=[[Radio Times]]|access-date=December 20, 2021}}</ref> as well as in a series of 2020{{ndash}}21 [[Geico]] commercials.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://billingsgazette.com/news/local/dehler-park-one-of-multiple-billings-locations-used-in-geico-ads/article_05df5d7a-5809-532e-97fa-76050128a0d3.html|title=Dehler Park one of multiple Billings locations used in Geico ads|last=Kordenbrock|first=Mike|date=May 4, 2021|website=[[Billings Gazette]]|access-date=December 20, 2021}}</ref>

The song is played at every [[Camp Randall Stadium|home game]] by the [[Wisconsin Badgers football|Wisconsin Badgers Football Team]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uwalumni.com/news/build-me-up-buttercup/|title=“Build Me Up Buttercup” | Wisconsin Alumni Association|website=www.uwalumni.com}}</ref> It was also played at every [[Los Angeles Angels]] home game during the seventh-inning stretch, before being eventually phased out for a rotation of variety of other songs. It is also a club anthem of Irish soccer club [[Shamrock Rovers F.C.|Shamrock Rovers]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bollinger |first=Rhett |date=2021-02-11 |title=A brief history of Angel Stadium's music |url=https://www.mlb.com/news/angel-stadium-music-history |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250329182330/https://www.mlb.com/news/angel-stadium-music-history |archive-date=2025-03-29 |access-date=2025-04-09 |website=MLB.com |language=en}}</ref>
sections.text:
"Build Me Up Buttercup" is featured in the 1998 romantic comedy film There's Something About Mary, the pilot episode "Truth Be Told" from the first season of the ABC TV spy drama series Alias, and the episode "Art Imitates Art" from the fourth season of the CBS TV detective series Elementary. This song was played during the final scene of the second to last episode of Fuller House. The track also features in the 2020 film The Kissing Booth 2, as well as in a series of 2020{{ndash}}21 Geico commercials.

The song is played at every home game by the Wisconsin Badgers Football Team. It was also played at every Los Angeles Angels home game during the seventh-inning stretch, before being eventually phased out for a rotation of variety of other songs. It is also a club anthem of Irish soccer club Shamrock Rovers.
